errormessage: Legal Name is mandatory for all Business Partners.
Status is mandatory (A=Active, I=Inactive, B=Blocked, C=Closed).
Block Reason is mandatory when Status = Blocked (B).
Credit Limit for Natural Person (NAT) must not exceed 5,000.
Country must be a valid country code. Check country reference table.
Currency must be a valid ISO currency code.
Incoterms must be a valid Incoterms code (e.g. EXW, FOB, CIF, DDP).
